Thanks again for agreeing to co-host a technical partner webcast with us. High level: we want a 45-minute developer-focused session (20m joint demo + 15m architecture deep-dive + 10m live Q&A) targeted at integrators and platform engineers. Proposed date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026, 10:00 PT.

Initial asks / next steps:
- Can you confirm two speakers (one PM/engineering + one Dev advocate) by Jul 22?
- Do you have any constraints on recording rights / reuse? Redwood typically records and keeps a gated on-demand asset; we can set a 90-day exclusive window if you prefer.

- I'll draft a mutual action plan (MAP) and propose the promotion cadence; can you confirm if SignalForge has a paid promotion budget for the webcast?

I've attached a rough agenda to kick off.

Best,
